 Explore your next opportunity at a Fortune Global 500 organization. Envision innovative possibilities, experience our rewarding culture, and work with talented teams that help you become better every day. We know what it takes to lead UPS into tomorrow—people with a unique combination of skill + passion. If you have the qualities and drive to lead yourself or teams, there are roles ready to cultivate your skills and take you to the next level.
 
 
 Job Description: 
 
 Job Summary 
 We are seeking a skilled Java Developer with strong experience in Spring Boot, Microservices to design, develop, and support business-critical solutions. The role involves working in an Agile environment, delivering high-quality software, ensuring production stability, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to enhance application performance and reliability.
 The ideal candidate will have hands-on expertise in Java, REST APIs, SQL databases, OpenShift/Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, and production support . They should be proficient in troubleshooting complex issues, performing root cause analysis, implementing preventive solutions, and maintaining technical documentation. Strong debugging, monitoring, and incident management skills, along with a commitment to code quality through unit testing and peer reviews, are essential for success in this role.

 
 Responsibilities: 
 Develop and enhance payment processing applications using Java, Spring Boot, and Microservices architecture. 
 Work in an Agile/Scrum environment, participating in sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, retrospectives, and release activities. 
 Provide production support for business-critical payment applications and ensure high system availability. 
 Troubleshoot and debug application, deployment, and infrastructure issues by analyzing application logs, server logs, and monitoring dashboards. 
 Monitor production alerts and proactively resolve incidents to minimize customer impact. 
 Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for production issues and implement preventive solutions. 
 Write and maintain JUnit test cases to ensure code quality, reliability, and regression coverage. 
 Create and maintain technical documentation, including design documents, implementation details, deployment guides, and operational runbooks. 
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams including DevOps, QA, Product Owners, and external payment service providers. 
 Participate in code reviews and enforce coding standards and best practices. 
 
 Required Technical Skills 
 Java, Spring Boot, Microservices 
 REST API development and integration 
 SQL Server / Relational Databases 
 JUnit and unit testing frameworks 
 Git, Azure DevOps, CI/CD Pipelines, GCP 
 OpenShift (OCP4) / Kubernetes deployments 
 Application log analysis and debugging 
 Monitoring tools such as Grafana, Dynatrace and Argo CD 
 Production incident management and support 
 Technical documentation and knowledge sharing 
 Qualifications: 
 Bachelor’s Degree or International equivalent 
 
 Employee Type: 
 
Permanent 
 UPS is committed to providing a workplace free of discrimination, harassment, and retaliation.
